# Geležinio Vilko Saga (The Iron Wolf Saga)

## Overview
An epic dark fantasy narrative set in 14th-century Lithuania. A multi-book series exploring historical fiction through the lens of power, betrayal, and transformation during Lithuania's turbulent medieval period.

## Story Details
- **Setting:** XIV century Lithuania during internal conflicts and the struggle against the Teutonic Order
- **Protagonist:** Vytautas' transformation from outcast to political player
- **Themes:** Redemption, political intrigue, historical fantasy, cultural identity

## Available Formats
- Online reading
- PDF/EPUB downloads
- Audiobook version available on YouTube

## Language
Lithuanian (Lietuvių)
